objective: Repair P5F by separating effect/cache eligibility from reordering authorization and failing closed without pairwise, source-bound ReorderCapability receipts.

policy.default: Every operator is fixed for reordering unless it belongs to a contiguous admitted region of at least two operators.
policy.region_admission: Every unordered pair inside the region has exactly one valid Supported commutes receipt, and no member already has a P5A barrier.
policy.conflict: Missing, duplicate, unsupported, unknown, stale, malformed, or ambiguously oriented receipts do not authorize a pair.
policy.backend_semantics: cedar may enumerate arbitrary permutations inside an unfixed region, so pairwise completeness is required; fixed operators form region boundaries.

required_tests: schema and standard-library validator accept a valid receipt
P5F noncommutative pipeline with no receipts fixes all operators
the repaired cedar plan preserves the original order and output
three pairwise-commuting operators with all three receipts retain a six-plan search space
the commuting optimized plan may reorder but preserves output
missing one receipt prevents a three-operator unrestricted region
source or contract drift invalidates affected receipts
a P5A barrier is never cleared
claim_boundary: Mechanism calibration on synthetic Python functions and one fixed cedar profile. ReorderCapabilityV0 is not yet inferred automatically and is not independent final evidence.
